_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 11: January 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says they act by faith regardless, that he is not moved by what he sees or feels, and that even if his children pick up a virus at school it will not last long in the body.
mentions.quote: may get a virus when they go to school but it's not going to last
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on standing in faith rather than on what is seen
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal exemption from illness with a faith condition attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are seeing the first fruits, repeats first the blade then the ear then the full manifestation, and calls 2025 a year of great outpouring that they will start to see.
mentions.quote: 2025 will be a year of great outpouring I believe it
mentions.falsify_match: A revival of measurable scale during 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though the first-fruits framing absorbs a slow year.

mentions.claim_text: He says a window has been given to bring in the lost, four years to the next shmita cycle, and that he is believing they go home in the rapture of the church by 2028 after a great harvest.
mentions.quote: a great opportunity to go home in the Rapture of the church by uh 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The rapture occurring by the end of 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, which is checkable at that date.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that Christ paid the price for the hearer to walk in victory, healing, deliverance and prosperity rather than living poor or barely getting by.
mentions.quote: he paid the price for you to walk in healing deliverance
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying many of his ministers started out right, and that the reason they fall into adultery is looking horizontally at everyone else instead of vertically.
mentions.quote: there's many of my ministers that started out right
mentions.falsify_match: A run of adultery scandals among prominent ministers.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears ministers putting the return at 2040 or 2050, insists no man knows the day or hour, but says he has spoken to Christ and seen him and was told I am coming soon, while admitting he does not know what soon means.
mentions.quote: he said I'm coming soon what does that mean I truly don't know
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and he says so: soon is left undefined on purpose.

mentions.claim_text: He describes ear defenders for his daughter Megan, who will not keep them on, and says they are believing for her to be completely healed as they close out the year.
mentions.quote: she's going to be completely healed is what we're believing for
mentions.falsify_match: A documented recovery for his daughter, which the family would report.
mentions.falsify_miss: No recovery; the claim has been standing since at least 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes their prayers changed a lot of things over the roughly hundred days from 5 November to 20 January, and that God used the audience.
mentions.quote: I believe our prayers changed a lot of things this last
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the counterfactual is asserted, not observed.

mentions.claim_text: Direct encouragement to viewers watching alone that they have what it takes, can make it, and that Jesus has a plan for their life.
mentions.quote: you've got what it takes and you can make it in this day
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: encouragement.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord will see to it that your pet is with you in heaven because God cares about the smallest details.
mentions.quote: the Lord's going to see to it that your pet's with you in heaven
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a claim about the afterlife.

mentions.claim_text: Describing an attack he saw in Las Vegas, he says he sees leaves on trees and a warmer climate, notes that Las Vegas is warm year round, and says he does not know whether it is February, March or April.
mentions.quote: is it in February is it March April I don't know folks
mentions.falsify_match: An attack in Las Vegas in the warmer months.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and he removes the month himself.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are looking up because their redemption draws near, and that in 2025 they will not just survive but thrive.
mentions.quote: we're not just going to survive in 25 we're going to thrive in 25
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcomes over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says the year just closing was one in which they soared and went from glory to glory, and that 2025 will be a year of supernatural provision, heaven on earth, which he says he has seen.
mentions.quote: it'll be a supernatural year of of of of God's Supernatural provision
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer calling peace over Russia and the Ukraine deal and over the southern border, and thanking God for an extended time of grace and an amazing 2025.
mentions.quote: we call Peace over Russia and over the Ukraine deal
mentions.falsify_match: A Russia Ukraine settlement during 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: The war continues, against this declaration but for war-season-2025-russia.

mentions.claim_text: He describes people forming a strong bond of faith and banding together as brothers from Jordan all the way across, while Iran is attacked and treated like a red-headed stepchild.
mentions.quote: we must band together as brothers from Jordan all the way across
mentions.falsify_match: A regional bloc forming across Jordan and its neighbours while Iran is struck and isolated.

mentions.claim_text: Answering viewers who say he missed the October call, he says he did not, because in October the Lord told him that since his people humbled themselves and prayed and turned from their wicked ways he is healing their land and scripture is being fulfilled.
mentions.quote: you missed that no I did not October I told you all
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the unmet October event is replaced by a granted healing of the land.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that everything they put their hands to prosper in 2025 with great acceleration and not decrease, and he notes that drill baby drill is a word he prophesied and Trump has now said.
mentions.quote: we will drill baby drill that word was Pro that I prophesied
mentions.falsify_match: The prior drill baby drill statement can be located in the corpus before Trump used it.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior statement, or it postdates the slogan being widely used.

mentions.claim_text: Describing his method to Alex Jones as looking into a vision and describing what he sees, he says he sees a rocket ship taking off after the 20th with the economy, and that the Lord called the great economy crash a planned one.
mentions.quote: I see a a rocket ship taking off after the 20th with the economy
mentions.falsify_match: A sharp economic upturn after 20 January 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He blesses the fruit of the womb, says God wants quivers full, and that 2025 is a time for children including possibly twins as restoration for what was lost in the past.
mentions.quote: maybe you have twins who knows for the time that you that you lost
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable at corpus level: births among an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: Anticipating disbelief, he insists he saw it with his own eyes and studied it for a minute, and says God puts his super on your natural even if it seems flaky.
mentions.quote: with my own eyes how is that possible Brandon I have no idea
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an appeal to his own eyewitness.

mentions.claim_text: Closing thanks and the standard sign off, with a note about the channel's plans for 2025.
mentions.quote: channel for uh this year 2025
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sign off.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing so many men coming out of Syria marching in a line like soldiers that they looked like ants, and that they were red and carrying guns, which he says he does not understand.
mentions.quote: there were so many men coming out of Syria and March in in a line
mentions.falsify_match: A mass armed movement out of Syria.

mentions.claim_text: He says a cleaning of the house is coming over sexual sin and financial corruption in the church, shown as a person being scrubbed down, and that the person was the church.
mentions.quote: sexual sins in the church SE bad financial things going on the church
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of exposures across churches over sexual and financial misconduct.

mentions.claim_text: He says more ministries will be called out, not only ones with large platforms and not only charismatics but all denominations including Catholics.
mentions.quote: going to see more Ministries being called out and a cleaning of the church
mentions.falsify_match: Scandals surfacing across multiple denominations rather than one tradition.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord says that even more in 2025 people will see faces coming seemingly out of nowhere, new people called by God walking in an anointing never seen before.
mentions.quote: in 2025 you will see faces that will it seem like they come out
mentions.falsify_match: Previously unknown figures rising to prominence in ministry during 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says praying over the fires felt like pushing against mud, and the Lord showed him the condition: if his people humble themselves and turn from their wicked ways they will hear from heaven and he will heal their land, but if not.
mentions.quote: it's like pushing against uh mud is sometimes what I felt like
mentions.condition_text: healing of the land conditioned on national repentance
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the repentance condition explains either outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says the destruction in cities that turned their back on God shows seed time and harvest accelerating, and that what will be seen through 2025 is just the beginning.
mentions.quote: what you will see over this whole year of 2025 this is just the beginning
mentions.falsify_match: Escalating urban disasters through 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Working from the warning that many false prophets will arise, he reasons that many means hundreds, and tells viewers to be on guard that they may be listening to one.
mentions.quote: if there's hundreds of false prophets out there probably be on guard
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and notable: he raises the possibility that his own audience should be checking him.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is coming like a snowball rolling downhill getting bigger, that he feels a wall when praying against the California fires, and that the fires are a taste of what is about to happen.
mentions.quote: it's a taste about what's fixing to happen folks
mentions.falsify_match: Disasters escalating in scale beyond the January 2025 fires.

mentions.claim_text: He says there can be a hedge over your own area but there is an open door over cities that have let in what is coming, and that people will see something they never thought they would see as their cities burn.
mentions.quote: there is an Open Door over your cities that have that have have let in
mentions.condition_text: personal protection conditioned on your own household while the city is judged
mentions.falsify_match: Further major American cities burning.
mentions.falsify_miss: No further city fires of that scale.

mentions.claim_text: He says a greater capacity is coming and repeats that he told them of a dividing of a line, then says that if anyone feels he is off they should keep it to themselves because they will see he was right.
mentions.quote: if you feel in your heart I'm off then keep it to yourself
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth noting against JKPqjW92sdc@1960 in the same video, where he tells them to be on guard against false prophets.

mentions.claim_text: He notes lightning striking One World Trade Center, the Empire State Building, the Capitol and the Washington Monument, says it was not coincidence, that all four happened before the new year for 2025, and reads it as a sign.
mentions.quote: this was not coincidence it all happened before the new year for 2025
mentions.falsify_match: Judgment falling on the institutions those four landmarks represent.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing follows, though no consequence is dated.

mentions.claim_text: An appeal that God is yelling at the top of his lungs because he does not want anyone to perish, and a call to decide now whom you will serve.
mentions.quote: doesn't want any of you to perish and go to hell not one of you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an appeal.
